title: Craftable trident(byGTX9999)
description: The Trident can finally be crafted!
body:
Starting today, the trident can finally be crafted! You can craft a trident at the workbench in a T-shape: place three prismarine shards on top and two blaze rods below to craft a trident. Of course, you can still obtain it from drowned mobs.

Note: This idea is not mine; it comes from a Chinese mod creator: Daniel. Thanks to him.
